briefing.headline: XP plunges 48.36% while XNCR rockets 37.86% in volatile overnight trade
briefing.summary: The overnight session was dominated by broad weakness across the core U.S. tech giants, with eight of the ten major stocks slipping and only TSLA posting a gain. Mega‑cap indices SPY and QQQ were essentially flat to slightly down, underscoring a risk‑off tone. In contrast, fringe tokens saw extreme moves, highlighted by XP’s 48% drop and XNCR’s 38% surge. Breadth was narrow, with just one advancer versus nine decliners among the core group.
